procs: 743977 bash            bash -c cd /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/audio-shokunin && python3 -c " import subprocess, time, os, signal, tempfile from pathlib import Path import wave, numpy as np # build 8s tag tone n = 48000*8; t = np.arange(n)/48000 pcm = np.empty(n*2, dtype='<i2') pcm[0::2] = (8192*np.sin(2*np.pi*1000*t)).astype('<i2') pcm[1::2] = (8192*np.sin(2*np.pi*1500*t)).astype('<i2') tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp() tone = Path(tmp)/'t.wav' with wave.open(str(tone),'wb') as w:     w.setnchannels(2); w.setsampwidth(2); w.setframerate(48000); w.writeframes(pcm.tobytes()) mid = subprocess.run(['pactl','load-module','module-null-sink','sink_name=r78z_probe'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout.strip() try:     feed = subprocess.Popen(['pw-cat','-p','-P','node.name=r78z_feed','--target','r78z_probe',str(tone)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)     time.sleep(0.5)     out = Path(tmp)/'cap.wav'     cap = subprocess.Popen(['pw-record','-P','stream.capture.sink=true','-P','node.name=r78z_cap','--target','r78z_probe','-n',str(int(4.8*48000)),'--rate','48000','--channels','2','--format','s16',str(out)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL)     time.sleep(1.6)     # watch link map right after -d, live     for a,b in [('r78z_probe:monitor_FL','r78z_cap:input_FL'),('r78z_probe:monitor_FR','r78z_cap:input_FR')]:         p = subprocess.run(['pw-link','-d',a,b],capture_output=True,text=True); print('d',p.returncode,p.stderr[:60])     for i in range(6):         time.sleep(0.3)         lm = subprocess.run(['pw-link','-l'],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout         has = 'r78z_probe:monitor_FL' in lm         # find if r78z_cap input shows a link         idx = lm.find('r78z_cap:input_FL')         seg = lm[idx:idx+300] if idx>=0 else ''         print(f't+{1.6+0.3*(i+1):.1f}: monitor port in map={has} cap-input seg={seg[:140]!r}')     cap.wait(timeout=10)     print('cap rc:', cap.returncode, 'size:', out.stat().st_size)     data = out.read_bytes()     off = data.find(b'data')     arr = np.memmap(out, dtype='<i2', mode='r', offset=off+8).reshape(-1,2)     for w in range(0,48,4):         seg = arr[w*4800:(w+1)*4800,0].astype(np.float64)         mag = np.abs(np.fft.rfft(seg*np.hanning(len(seg))))         print(f'win {w*0.1:.1f}s peak={int(4*mag.max()/len(seg))} f={int(np.fft.rfftfreq(len(seg),1/48000)[np.argmax(mag)])}')     feed.wait(timeout=10); print('feed rc:', feed.returncode) finally:     subprocess.run(['pactl','unload-module',mid],capture_output=True) " 2>&1
